tools.name: device_list
tools.description: List ADB-visible physical devices and emulators.

tools.name: device_inspect
tools.description: Inspect one explicitly selected device, including API, ABI, display and optionally processes.

tools.name: toolchain_probe
tools.description: Resolve and verify host and target toolchains; reports provenance and capabilities.

tools.name: workspace_open
tools.description: Open a local project or APK workspace without executing project-controlled code.

tools.name: workspace_describe
tools.description: Describe modules, build system, targets, variants, packages, sources and artifacts.

tools.name: workspace_trust
tools.description: Grant a scoped trust permission for project-controlled operations after explicit host/user approval. This is not a sandbox.

tools.name: workspace_revoke_trust
tools.description: Revoke a workspace trust grant and invalidate cached permissions for future project-controlled execution.

tools.name: app_build
tools.description: Build an explicitly selected workspace target. Project code execution requires Workspace Trust.

tools.name: app_install
tools.description: Install an artifact on an explicitly selected device; supports a single APK or split set artifact.

tools.name: app_launch
tools.description: Launch an application on an explicitly selected device and return a verified process instance.

tools.name: session_start
tools.description: Create a device/project debugging session and optionally start the app and log collector.

tools.name: session_status
tools.description: Read process, backend, suspension lease, capability and subsystem states.

tools.name: session_stop
tools.description: Stop a session and clean up backend/collector resources; app force-stop is opt-in.

tools.name: ui_inspect
tools.description: Capture a fresh normalized live UI hierarchy.

tools.name: ui_find
tools.description: Find UI elements with a selector and optional expected generation.

tools.name: ui_act
tools.description: Perform a policy-checked UI action and verify the resulting UI state.

tools.name: ui_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot, optionally annotated, and return image content plus artifact reference.

tools.name: logcat_start
tools.description: Start persistent raw logcat capture for accessible buffers.

tools.name: logcat_stop
tools.description: Stop a collector and finalize coverage and artifact metadata.

tools.name: logcat_query
tools.description: Query indexed logs with bounded pagination and process-instance filtering.

tools.name: logcat_statistics
tools.description: Read collector metrics and accessible logd buffer statistics.

tools.name: logcat_health
tools.description: Read collector loss, device log loss and coverage state.

tools.name: debug_attach
tools.description: Attach a selected debugger backend to a verified process instance. Pass switchBackend=true to detach another backend first for sequential JDI/LLDB use; simultaneous inspection is not supported.

tools.name: debug_detach
tools.description: Detach one debugger backend without implicitly terminating the debugging session or target app.

tools.name: debug_status
tools.description: Read coordinated process execution, stop epoch and independent backend statuses.

tools.name: debug_breakpoint_add
tools.description: Add a source, function or exception breakpoint.

tools.name: debug_breakpoints_list
tools.description: List breakpoints and their resolution state.

tools.name: debug_breakpoint_remove
tools.description: Remove a breakpoint by ID.

tools.name: debug_pause
tools.description: Pause a target process or thread through the selected debugger backend.

tools.name: debug_continue
tools.description: Resume only suspension leases owned by the requesting backend.

tools.name: debug_step
tools.description: Step into, over or out on a suspended thread.

tools.name: debug_threads
tools.description: List threads and state for the selected backend.

tools.name: debug_stack
tools.description: Inspect stack frames from an active stop epoch.

tools.name: debug_variables
tools.description: Inspect locals and scopes using a valid epoch-scoped frame handle.

tools.name: debug_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate only policy-approved expressions. Java/Kotlin uses read-only subset; Dart evaluation is explicitly capability and side-effect classified; arbitrary native evaluation is unavailable in v1.

tools.name: debug_modules
tools.description: List loaded modules and symbol/build-ID match information.

tools.name: debug_registers
tools.description: Read register groups for a stopped native thread.

tools.name: debug_memory_read
tools.description: Read bounded memory from a stopped native process.

tools.name: profiler_systemtrace_start
tools.description: Start an explicit Perfetto/systemtrace profiling session.

tools.name: profiler_systemtrace_stop
tools.description: Stop systemtrace and persist the Perfetto trace artifact.

tools.name: profiler_heapdump_capture
tools.description: Capture a JVM heap dump for a supported debuggable process.

tools.name: performance_trace_analyze
tools.description: Analyze a stored Perfetto trace artifact.

tools.name: preview_list
tools.description: List build-time Compose Preview descriptors for a trusted workspace.

tools.name: preview_render
tools.description: Render a build-time Compose Preview artifact.

tools.name: analyze_artifact
tools.description: Analyze an APK/AAB/AAR/JAR or stored build artifact with machine-readable output.

tools.name: diagnostics_timeline
tools.description: Query an event timeline preserving source order and clock uncertainty.

tools.name: diagnostics_crashes
tools.description: List crashes and accessible ANR evidence for a session/process.

tools.name: diagnostics_analyze
tools.description: Run evidence-based diagnosis over a selected session/time range.

tools.name: artifact_get
tools.description: Retrieve metadata, raw or redacted representation of a session-owned artifact.

tools.name: signals_crashes
tools.description: Read authenticated Crashlytics field telemetry when available; otherwise return the local device crash buffer. Never initiates interactive authentication.

tools.name: compose_inspect
tools.description: Runtime Compose inspection of reported accessibility semantics for TREE; RECOMPOSITION and TRACE report unsupported without Compose runtime instrumentation.

resources.description: Versioned public tool catalog and capability metadata.
Current session, process, backend and subsystem states.
Raw/parsed log capture metadata and query guidance.
Session-owned artifact metadata and content representation.
